senses.gloss: to moisten, v. רָטָה.—Part. pass. רָטוּב (b. h. רָטֹב); f. רְטוּבָה; pl. רְטוּבִים, רְטוּבִין; רְטוּבוֹת (interch. with רוֹטֵב &c.).
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:6">Koh. R. to VI, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4:2">Lev. R. s. 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00658"><he>סִילּוֹן</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>תמרים רטובים</he> (some ed. <he>רוֹטְבִין</he>) juicy (good) dates, opp. <he>נובלות</he>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII, 13</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:6">T’bul Yom III, 6</cite> <he>תמרים רטובות</he> (Ar. ed. pr. <he>רוֹטְבוֹת</he>); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10<sup>21</sup></cite> <he>ונוטל את הרטוב</he> some ed., read: <he>הרוֹטֶב</he>.]

senses.gloss: same, to be green, succulent; to thrive.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:6">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>וישראל מַרְטִיבִין והולכים</he> and Israel shall thrive more and more; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite>.
Ib. כשושנת … שמַרְטֶבֶת והולכת like the lily of the valleys, which is continually green; a. e.—ה׳ מעשים טובים to be succulent with good deeds.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1">Ib. 1</cite> <he>הִרְטַבְתִּי מ׳ ט׳ כשושנה</he> I became filled with the sap of good deeds like the lily; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:17">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 3</cite> <he>ה׳ במעשים וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="L00227"><he>לוז</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 35:6">Gen. XXXV, 6</cite>) <he>כל מי … ה׳ מצות ומ׳ ט׳ כלוז</he> whosoever entered it became filled with pious acts and good deeds like a nut-tree; (<cite ref="Genesis 35:6">ib.</cite> s. 69, a. e. <cite ref="I00859"><he>הטריף</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="I00859"><he>טָרַף</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cover with green foliage, to improvise a cover with foliage. Ib. s. 68 מה רטיבה ה׳ וכ׳ what was the cover which he (Jacob) prepared? ‘The beams of our house are cedars’ (Cant. I, 17); Cant. R. to I, 17 ומה הרטבה ה׳ מהן (strike out מהן); (Yalk. Gen. 119 ומה טריפה הטריף, Var. רטיבה ה׳, v. טָרַף).—[Cant. R. to VI, 10 מרטבת, v. שָׁבַה Hithpa.]
